About Us
ABOUT OUR COLLEGE
Masters Pre-University College, one of the finest institutions with potential for excellence, is located in Hassan, Karnataka. It is known for providing high quality education in Science for Pre-University students. It creates an exceptional space for an enhanced learning experience by providing the students multiple academic pathways and curricula to best suit their interests and strengths.
It is formed under the auspices of Masters Education Trust in 2012-13. A fresh chapter began then in Hassan in the Pre-University Science stream by successfully bridging the gap between the board exam and all other competitive exams under one umbrella. Since its inception, it has achieved incredible results in both academic and competitive exams like CET/JEE/NEET. It has been giving best coaching for aforementioned competitive exams along with the academic teaching. We feel rejoiced to say that our institution has persistently produced excellent results, securing one of the top 5 positions in state and it has maintained the district top 5 positions every year since its establishment. Every year, our students get considerable ranking and get placed in reputed Engineering, Medical and Agricultural colleges.  We are glad that most of our students have already been selected and working in different firms in India and abroad.
We have a large pool of well experienced faculty for all the subjects. The optional subjects [PCMB] are headed by our distinguished founders of the institute that is Sri Gowde Gowda [H.O.D of Physics], Sri T.A.H Rayudu [H.O.D of Chemistry], Smt.H.C. Nandini [H.O.D of Mathematics] and Sri B.S.Manjunatha [H.O.D of Biology]. Our faculty members are subject matter experts in their respective fields and are dedicated in offering one-on-one support to enhance the child’s comprehension of topics. We provide the students excellent study materials with a well-planned curriculum to facilitate their studies. We have very good infrastructure with well-equipped laboratories which help the students to do better in their academic career. We have a good library with a number of books on all subjects. We have hostel facility with caring wardens and healthy food and hence, “Masters is a home away from home”.
The vision of the Masters Education Trust is to provide high quality education of global standards. As we always believe in “striving to do better” every year, our commitment is towards the progress of the institution which enabled us to have reached this stage in a short span of 10 years and motivated us to aim ahead. While pursuing our result report, you will experience the commitment of the institution in imparting exceptionally quality education in its true sense. The annual result report is not only a record of our journey of the academic years, but it also captures the dreams and aspirations of the years to come as the Goddesses Saraswathi has bestowed on us abundantly to continue this journey of excellence.

B S MANJUNATHA
“A good education is a foundation for a better future.”
Elizabeth warren
Masters Pre-University College is a symbol of progressive and quality education in Science. As the principal of this esteemed institute, I take the opportunity to thank all our well wishers, especially our parents who have unconditionally trusted us and whole heartedly supported us. We are committed to encourage positive communication and interaction among students, teachers and the wider community. We welcome the support and guidance of the wider community to train our students in our endeavor to build a better society and a better world at large. We promise an academic environment which is conducive for learning and achievement of the students.
At the end, I would like to extend my best wishes to all our students, staff, parents and alumni. I wish that the career of our students will rise to great heights and they will cherish all their dreams after successfully completing education from our college.
Wishing you all success and bright future,
